products.name: Yoroll
products.tagline: Build playable stories without a game engine
products.description: Yoroll lets anyone turn stories into playable, cinematic games without coding or a game engine. Start with a script, image, or video clip, then direct the scenes, add player choices, and create branching storylines with different outcomes. AI helps bring everything together into an interactive experience you can share. It's more like directing your own interactive movie than programming a game.
maker_comments: Yoroll is doing something pretty interesting with AI video. Instead of generating clips that people just watch, it lets you turn them into interactive games with choices, different endings, and playable moments. You can start with a prompt, image, or video, then build and publish the experience without a traditional game engine. They've already got a playable version of The Odyssey with 140+ AI-generated scenes and 11 endings. Worth trying if you've ever wanted to turn a story into a game.

Hi guys! 👋 We are the LinearGame team, and we’re launching Yoroll on Product Hunt today. When we showed Yoroll at GDC and NVIDIA GTC, we kept hearing some version of “I’ve always wanted to make a game, but I never knew how to start.” That stuck with us. If you write short dramas or make AI videos, you might already know exactly where you’d let the audience take the story in a different direction. Getting that one choice to work on screen is where things get fiddly. We built Yoroll so you can start with whatever you’ve got. Got a story in mind? Bring a premise, a script, or a few reference images into Yoroll Agent. You can work out where each choice leads, review the storyboard, and pick which shots to turn into video. Then play it through and see how the story feels from the other side of the screen. Open Yoroll Agent Got a game idea? With Yoroll Code, you can build a standalone mini-game or a playable moment inside a story. Say the player has to pick a lock before a guard comes back. Try it in your browser, tweak the timer, and play it again. You’ve got Tripo 3D, Seedance video, sound effects, and the game engine in the same workspace. Try Yoroll Code Already shot a short drama? Say your lead signs a deal in the original cut. What if the audience could make her walk away? Keep the footage you shot, generate the walkout scene, and choose where that path rejoins the original story. Try the interactive drama tool For Black Friday, members can save up to 60% on Claude Fable 5.2 in Yoroll Code！ Thanks for giving Yoroll a look. If you try it, we’d love to hear what felt good, what got in your way, or what you wish it could do. And if you just want to talk about the product or kick around an idea you’re working on, we’re here for that too. 🙌

products.name: Rankhog
products.tagline: Get customers from Reddit on autopilot
products.description: Rankhog finds people on Reddit asking for what you sell. It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? Rankhog warms up a new one, and you own it. Run it from the app, or from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. 7 days free.
maker_comments: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Anthony, and I build Rankhog on my own. People ask Reddit what to buy all day. "What do you use for X?" is a customer raising their hand in public. But doing Reddit well is a full time job. Every subreddit has its own rules, new accounts get removed, and one lazy promo comment can get you banned. So I built Rankhog to do the boring parts for me: Radar watches the subreddits your buyers hang out in and finds people asking for what you sell, while the post is still fresh. Replies that help first. Rankhog reads the subreddit's rules, writes a reply in its style, then checks it like a strict mod. It names your product only when it fits. You say yes, or autopilot does. Replies go out from your own Reddit account, at a human pace. Warm-up. No account? Make a fresh one and Rankhog grows it with real, helpful comments. You own it, not us. Works with your AI. Run all of it from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client. What it is not: a spam bot. No mass comments, no bought accounts, no posting where the rules say no. You can start with a free Reddit audit of your product, and there are free tools too (shadowban checker, post checker, best time to post). The plan is $99 a month per product with a 7 day free trial. I would love to hear it straight: what has Reddit done for your product so far, good or bad? I'm here all day to answer.

products.name: Resurf
products.tagline: Personal Knowledge Base & Bookmark Manager for Mac
products.description: A fully local personal context library for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Save notes, links, images, and documents. Hand off context to AI through MCP or the CLI on Mac.
maker_comments: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Deep, a design engineer and the maker of Resurf. As a design engineer, I come across a lot of design references, articles, websites and little details I want to keep. Sometimes it’s an interaction I like, sometimes a useful read, sometimes just something that gives me an idea for a project. I’d save these across browser bookmarks, screenshots, folders and notes. But when I needed a reference again, I often couldn’t remember where I’d put it. So I built Resurf. It started as a small capture widget and grew into a personal library for references, research, notes and ideas. A lot of my taste comes from the things I’ve collected over time and the notes I leave about why I liked them. As AI makes building things faster, I think that personal context becomes more valuable. Through MCP, I can bring those saved references into Claude, Cursor or Codex when I’m working on something. Since the first launch, I’ve rebuilt Resurf from Electron to native Swift and added: Semantic Search and Similar Vibe: find something by describing what you remember, or discover related captures across your library. Both run locally on Mac. Smart Spaces: turn a search or filter into a collection that updates as you save. Custom AI actions: extract details, generate titles and tags, or suggest Spaces using your own AI provider, including Ollama. Better reading and notes: highlight articles, leave comments, search inside PDFs and add images to notes. Quick capture: save from your browser, double-tap Option, or drop things onto your Mac’s notch. Resurf is native on Mac, iPhone and iPad. Your library stays on your devices, with optional sync through your own iCloud. AI features are optional. Try it at resurf.so 🙂

products.tagline: Gifts so personal, your prospects take the meeting.
products.description: Daymaker is known for coldcakes, that ends today. Daymaker is the tool that researches your prospects, finds out their interests, recommends a personalized gift, repackages it in your branding, and sends it to your prospect. Making sure you get your meeting. Want it done for you? We run the campaign and guarantee the meetings.

products.name: oovi
products.tagline: Your own team of AI on your desktop
products.description: Hand oovi a job and a team of AI bots does it: a leader plans, a researcher digs, a writer drafts, a critic checks. Watch each bot work, and approve anything before it goes out. Free with your own AI key, or from $10/mo with credits that never expire.
maker_comments: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Oussama, a solo developer from Algeria. I built oovi because running a one-person company means being the researcher, the writer, the marketer and the reviewer at the same time. I wanted a team, not another chat box. How it works: you give one request. A leader bot plans it and hands parts to specialists: a researcher that searches and reads sources, a writer that drafts, a critic that checks the result. You can open any bot's screen and watch it work. Anything that touches the outside world (sending an email, posting, clicking on a site) shows you the exact action and waits for your OK. What I cared about: • Your choice of model. Bring your own key (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, OpenRouter, or a local model) and oovi is free, with nothing added on top. Or use our built-in model from $10/month, and unused credits never expire. • Local-first. Chats, files and keys stay on your computer. • Your phone too. Talk to your team on Telegram, and routines keep running while your computer is off. • Your language. English, French, Arabic, Spanish, German, Turkish, and even Algerian Darija. Version 0.15.0 shipped this week: bots act instead of asking, conversations cost about half as much to start, and big spreadsheets are handled exactly. I'd love your honest feedback

products.name: Creavit Studio 4.0
products.tagline: Screen recording, iPhone camera and cinematic demos for Mac
products.description: Plan, record and turn your screen into a product story. Creavit Studio 4.0 brings QR-paired iPhone portrait capture, camera takes added after recording, Content Planner, Standard and Liquid MultiFocus, cinematic 3D MacBook and iPhone scenes, Smooth Scroll, Smooth Typing, your voice in another language, and Auto FX with your approval at every stage. Built for Mac. Also available on iPhone for recording and editing on the go.
maker_comments: Hi Product Hunt! I’m Onur, the maker of Creavit Studio. Creavit Studio 4.0 brings planning, recording and cinematic editing into one Mac app. This launch is about giving you more control over how a product story is told. Creavit Studio is also available on iPhone, so you can record and edit directly on your phone. Here’s what’s new: • Connect your iPhone by QR over Wi-Fi for 1080 × 1920 portrait camera capture. Record the screen and camera together, or add a camera take later while your edit plays. • Build a shot-by-shot plan with Content Planner, write a script for each shot, record takes and return to saved ideas in Library. • Show up to three details at once with MultiFocus: independent Standard cards or Liquid glass lenses. • Turn recordings into 3D MacBook scenes with animated lids and screen glow, or iPhone demos with animated hands, taps and swipes. • Smooth real scrolling and typing with their own editable controls. Translate speech and captions with your own voice sample and a local voice engine. • Work with Auto FX through proposed cuts, an approved scene plan and individual scenes, keeping the creative decisions in your hands. The video shows the new workflow, followed by real captures from the editor. I’d love to hear which part would help most with your next product demo, and what you’d want to control more precisely. Thanks for taking a look!

products.name: Webless Agents
products.tagline: Agents you want to put in front of customers
products.description: You wouldn’t put most website chatbots in front of a customer. Webless Agents are different: you describe the outcome you want in plain English, and Webless builds the agent on your published content, so it answers only from what you’ve said. You review every instruction and change anything before it goes live. Then it gets to work: answering questions, qualifying buyers, sending quotes, booking meetings and handing off to your team. For Product Hunt: 3 months of our highest plan, free.
maker_comments: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Suyog, co-founder of Webless. You'd never let most website bots near your customers. They are lead gen forms in disguise. They dead-end people with “please choose 1, 2 or 3,” and your best buyers leave. We built Webless Agents to be the opposite: agents you want to put in front of customers. Launching one takes just four steps: Describe it. Tell Webless the outcome you want, in plain English. No flowcharts. Webless builds it. Instructions, skills, guardrails, tools and outcomes, all written from your content. Every agent is grounded in your published content. If the answer is on your site, it finds it. If it isn’t, the agent says so or hands off to your team, instead of guessing. You approve it. Read every instruction, change anything. Nothing goes live until you say so. It goes to work. In the gallery, a Northwind agent asks three discovery questions, builds a 60-seat quote from the price book, books a meeting with Maya, and sends the transcript to Slack. Our customers see 5X conversions and 20% lower CAC. Try our highest plan for free for three months. Product Hunt Exclusive. I’ll be here all day. Tell me the first agent you’d build, and I’ll tell you how I’d set it up.

products.name: Omi CLI
products.tagline: AI coding agents that work while you're away.
products.description: Omi can build anything. Give Omi a coding task: it reads your repo, fixes bugs, runs your type check and tests and fixes what fails (/verify), and checks your app in a real browser. Parallel subagents work in separate worktrees; background and cloud agents keep going while you're away. New in 0.5.2: a redesigned terminal with a live status line, highlighted code and word-level diffs, and faster startup. 13 models or bring your own. Free to start: npm i -g @builditomi/cli
maker_comments: Hey Product Hunt! I'm Om, the maker of BuildItOmi. Our idea has always been simple: Omi can build anything. Omi CLI brings that to your terminal. What it does: Reads your repo, makes a plan, and shows every edit as a diff you approve (yes / no / always) Runs your tests and keeps going until they pass Auto picks the model for each turn from 13 models (DeepSeek, Gemini, Gemma, gpt-oss, GLM), so everyday edits stay cheap and hard problems get a stronger model /undo puts back every file the last task changed, even without git One plan in USD with clear 5-hour and weekly limits, and a Free plan to try it New in 0.5.0 (out today on npm): Subagents that edit in parallel, each in its own git worktree, merged back three-way Built-in browser testing: Omi opens your app in headless Chrome, clicks through it and reports console errors and failed requests Background agents (omi bg "task") that keep working after you close the terminal Cloud agents (omi cloud "task") that run on your repo's GitHub Actions and open a pull request Honest numbers: on our first public benchmark (10 small tasks, judged by hidden tests the agent never saw) Omi CLI solved 10 out of 10. It is a small sample, and the full runs are on cli.builditomi.com/benchmark. Try it: npm i -g @builditomi/cli, then run omi in any project. I would love your feedback: which task should Omi CLI get better at next?

products.name: Ulika
products.tagline: Visual editor for sites built with Claude, Cursor, or Codex
products.description: AI can ship a React, Vite, or Next site in a weekend. Then marketing wants a headline change and opens a ticket. Ulika connects the site so anyone can edit copy and images on the page and publish, without touching code. Open beta, free to try at ulika.co.
maker_comments: Hey everyone. I'm Mau, a product designer in Mexico City, and I made Ulika. The pattern I kept seeing: someone ships a React, Vite, or Next site in a weekend with Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Then marketing wants to change a headline or an image, and it turns into a ticket. The site is "done," but only the person who can open the repo can touch it. Ulika is a visual editor for those sites. You connect the project (GitHub + Vercel), Ulika detects it, and anyone on the team can edit copy and images on the page and hit Publish. No CMS migration. No asking engineering for a typo. We're in open beta and it's free to try at ulika.co. It already works on real sites, and we're still smoothing onboarding. If something is confusing or breaks, I want to hear it. The 40 second video walks through the full loop on a real detailing site: connect, edit the hero, add a service, publish. I'd love feedback on two things in particular: If you build sites with AI tools for clients or a marketing team, does this fit how you actually work? What's the most confusing part of connecting a project the first time? Happy to answer anything. Thanks for taking a look.

products.tagline: your screen recording, but in a 3D phone. free, no signup
products.description: ok so every time I launch an app I need one of those 3D phone videos, and every tool wants a download or a subscription. nope. built my own. you drop in a screen recording (or a screenshot, I don't judge), it shows up inside a 3D iPhone / MacBook / iPad / browser window, you pick a look, add a camera move, slap a headline on it, export MP4 up to 4K. runs in a browser tab. no upload, no signup, no watermark, no catch. it's free. go make your app look expensive.
maker_comments: hey PH 👋 maker here tl;dr: screen recording goes in, fancy 3D device video comes out, nothing leaves your laptop. I ship small apps, and every launch I need the same thing, one decent clip of the app in a phone that I can post the same day. everything good was a desktop app or a subscription, so I got annoyed and built it in a browser tab instead. how it goes: drop in a recording or screenshot, pick a device (iPhone, Pixel, iPad, MacBook, a watch, a browser window, or bring your own 3D model), grab one of six looks or go full control freak on background, lighting and camera, add a headline, tap marks, zoom and music, export MP4 up to 4K in 16:9, 9:16, 4:5 or 1:1. the part I'm weirdly proud of: it renders on your machine, so your unreleased app never touches a server. no account, no watermark, free. works best in Chrome or Edge on a laptop. roast it, tell me what's missing, tell me what broke. I'll fix it.
